ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, a promoter of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, has disclosed an open market acquisition of 66,659 shares (0.03% stake) in the target company. This transaction, executed on September 10, 2026, increases their total holding from 33.64% to 33.67%. While indicating a slight consolidation of promoter ownership, the acquisition's small size does not suggest any immediate material impact or present significant red flags from this disclosure alone.
